what: Contract data the geometry doesn't carry (P1-V02): mass split, hinges, collider kinds, anchors and LOD budgets. Pivots come from the model (model.js pivots()); the bake joins the two into cruz-missile.asset.json. Hinges are provisional: P1-V03's production pass places hinge lines and limits. +X is the car's left.

anchorNotes.cam_fp: Driver's eye: right-hand drive, so the car's right (-X).
anchorNotes.roof_number: On the roof crown, midway along the painted roof (stations z 0.14 and -0.32).
anchorNotes.lplate_front: On the lower fascia behind the bull bar.
anchorNotes.lplate_rear: Between the diffuser and the tail lamps.

colliderExclude.front: The UHF whip and its mount: a thin aerial is not a collision surface.
